method: Direct import of molecular.characterization from the exact pinned HEAD source (f8416b845efe93f9e47deca97f01a355e4e679ba), no pytest, no code repository changes, independent of the architect's probe and the implementer's own tests
note: Third independent pydantic patch version besides the architect's 2.14.0 and the implementer's reported 2.14.1 - reproduces identically across all three, which weakens any explanation resting on a pydantic version quirk
conclusion: Confirms, independently of the architect's architect-dto-strictness-probe.json, that CharacterizationValues and SdfParserParameters accept coercible non-native-type input (numeric strings into int/float fields; non-bool int into a Literal[True] field) despite frozen=True/extra="forbid" and the existing bool-rejection/non-finite/positivity field_validators. This is pydantic's default lax/coercive validation mode; model_config does not set strict=True and no field uses Field(strict=True).
